 Print CAT 2026 admit card to be released today The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore is set to release the Common Admission Test ( CAT ) 2026 admit card today, November 4, on its official website, iimcat.ac.in. Candidates who have registered for the examination will be able to download their hall tickets by logging in with their user ID and password. The CAT 2026 examination will be conducted on November 29 in three shifts. The examination is held for admission to Master of Business Administration (MBA) and other management programmes offered by IIMs and several other business schools across the country. Candidates must download their admit cards and check all the details mentioned on them before appearing for the examination. CAT 2026 admit card : How to download
 Candidates will be able to download the CAT 2026 hall ticket by following these steps: Visit the official website, iimcat.ac.in.
 Click on the CAT 2026 admit card link available on the homepage.
 Enter the required login details, including the user ID and password.
 Click on the submit option.
 The CAT 2026 admit card will appear on the screen.
 Check the details mentioned on the hall ticket and download it.
 Take a printout for future reference.
 CAT 2026 exam pattern and marking scheme
 The CAT 2026 question paper will have 68 questions divided into three sections. These include: Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC)
 Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR)
 Quantitative Ability (QA)
 According to the marking scheme, candidates will receive three marks for every correct answer. US Midterm Election Results 2026

 One mark will be deducted for each incorrect response. CAT 2026 scores validity and admission process
 The CAT 2026 scores will remain valid until December 31, 2027. Candidates should note that each IIM will follow its own admission criteria and selection process. Apart from CAT scores, IIMs may also consider candidates' Class 10 and Class 12 marks, graduation scores, work experience and other factors during the admission process. The selection criteria may also include minimum academic requirements and weightage assigned to different parameters. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official CAT website for the latest updates regarding the admit card and examination.
